name: KilliK
source:
The Painful Stranger

A natural disaster to the denizens of Hell, KilliK is a reviled entity who indiscriminately kills anyone she comes across in the realm. She wields an endless array of box cutters.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446499540230326]Steiner[/url]]
